findings: PReorder is insertion after an explicit predecessor, with NULL selecting head; no detach or priority enforcement.
Create modes0/1 use ascending p_priority with after/before equal tie policy; mode2 allows NULL=head, mode3 dereferences position. Invalid where returns allocation without insertion.
Create leaves x34_unk untouched and invalid mode leaves prev/next unset.
Relocation reverses owner procs before relinking, preserving child-chain order after head insertions; updates only matching prior generation markers.
Cleanup delegates user data then object then procs then GX then P list then allocator.
